description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Camille''' sweeps her leg in a cone in the target direction over 1.1 seconds, during which she is [[File:Ghost.png|20px|link=Unit collision|An icon representing the keyword Ghosted]] [[:Unit collision|ghosted]] and unable to declare basic attacks. Afterwards, she deals physical damage to all enemies within.
description.text: Active: Camille sweeps her leg in a cone in the target direction over 1.1 seconds, during which she is ghosted and unable to declare basic attacks. Afterwards, she deals physical damage to all enemies within.

description2.raw: Enemies hit by the outer half of the cone take '''additional''' physical damage, capped at 300 against [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]], and are [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] by 80% decaying over 2 seconds. '''Camille''' is [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healed]] for 100% of this '''additional''' damage post-mitigation against enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] in the outer half.
description2.text: Enemies hit by the outer half of the cone take additional physical damage, capped at 300 against monsters, and are slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds. Camille is healed for 100% of this additional damage post-mitigation against enemy champions in the outer half.

description3.raw: Non-epic monsters take 50% damage from ''Tactical Sweep''.
description3.text: Non-epic monsters take 50% damage from Tactical Sweep.

description4.raw: ''Other abilities can be cast during the animation without cancelling it.''
description4.text: Other abilities can be cast during the animation without cancelling it.

notes.raw: * '''Camille''' can move during the delay, but the hitbox and '''Camille's''' visuals are fixed to the initial target direction. ** '''Camille's''' facing-direction, for effects such as [[File:Cassiopeia Petrifying Gaze.png|20xpx|border|link=Cassiopeia#Petrifying Gaze|An icon for Cassiopeia's ability Petrifying Gaze]] [[Cassiopeia#Petrifying Gaze|Petrifying Gaze]], is the direction she is moving, and not the direction the model is facing. * The damage modifier against non-epic monsters applies after the cap. * Because the increased damage in the outer range of the cone is dealt as an '''additional''' instance of damage (as opposed to '''bonus''' damage to the original instance), it will trigger effects twice such as being reduced by [[File:Bone Plating rune.png|20xpx|link=Bone Plating|An icon representing Bone Plating]] [[Bone Plating]] an extra time.(unexpected) ** It still belongs to the same [[:Champion ability|cast instance]], therefore it does not trigger additional stacks of [[File:Conqueror rune.png|20xpx|link=Conqueror|An icon representing Conqueror]] [[Conqueror]] or [[File:Electrocute rune.png|20xpx|link=Electrocute|An icon representing Electrocute]] [[Electrocute]].
notes.text:
Camille can move during the delay, but the hitbox and Camille's visuals are fixed to the initial target direction.
* Camille's facing-direction, for effects such as Petrifying Gaze, is the direction she is moving, and not the direction the model is facing.
The damage modifier against non-epic monsters applies after the cap.
Because the increased damage in the outer range of the cone is dealt as an additional instance of damage (as opposed to bonus damage to the original instance), it will trigger effects twice such as being reduced by Bone Plating an extra time.(unexpected)
* It still belongs to the same cast instance, therefore it does not trigger additional stacks of Conqueror or Electrocute.
